name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0, introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub for Slack/Discord/Google over MCP, and a mobile-responsive layout. The data root structure changed — 'data/' is now a neutral home container and each Room is a top-level cabinet, with automatic migration for existing installs. Earlier v0.4.x patches (all 2026-04-30) fixed native module loading in signed macOS DMGs, Electron startup crashes, and wired up a multi-provider AI runtime with 8 CLI providers introduced in v0.4.0. The project was MIT licensed as of v0.4.0. See releases at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in April–May 2026 with 169+ commits in the latest release alone
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Not explicitly described; there is a profile/name/email onboarding flow and a legal acceptance flow, but no traditional user authentication system is mentioned

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration: 'data/' is now a neutral 'home' container and each room is a top-level cabinet; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and the redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation.
CLI: 'cabinetai' refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or '/' and recommends '~/Documents/Cabinet'.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet, but comes with greater setup complexity and heavier resource requirements.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with user permissions and workflows, but is heavier and more complex to deploy than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and metadata extraction, but requires more infrastructure setup compared to Cabinet's simpler approach.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a vastly broader ecosystem with apps, collaboration, and cloud sync, but is much heavier and more complex than Cabinet's focused file cabinet use case.

alternatives.name: FileGator
alternatives.review: FileGator is similarly lightweight and easy to self-host for file management, but lacks document-specific features like tagging, OCR, or metadata management that Cabinet targets.
